mcqs.question: What is inheritance in object-oriented programming?
options: A mechanism where a class derives properties and behavior from another class
mcqs.answer: A mechanism where a class derives properties and behavior from another class

mcqs.question: What is the class being inherited from commonly called?
mcqs.answer: Parent class

mcqs.question: What is the class that inherits from another class commonly called?
mcqs.answer: Child class

mcqs.question: Which syntax is used to inherit from a class named `Animal`?
mcqs.answer: class Dog(Animal):

mcqs.question: What is another common name for a parent class?
mcqs.answer: Base class

mcqs.question: What is another common name for a child class?
mcqs.answer: Derived class

mcqs.question: Which Python class is the ultimate base class for ordinary new-style classes?
mcqs.answer: object

mcqs.question: Which function can be used to determine whether one class is a subclass of another?
mcqs.answer: issubclass()

mcqs.question: What does `issubclass(Dog, Animal)` check?
options: Whether Dog is a subclass of Animal
Whether Dog is an instance of Animal
Whether Animal is an object of Dog
Whether both classes have the same methods
mcqs.answer: Whether Dog is a subclass of Animal

mcqs.question: Which built-in function checks whether an object belongs to a class or its subclasses?
mcqs.answer: isinstance()

mcqs.question: What is single inheritance?
options: A class inherits from one direct parent class
Several classes inherit from one child
A class inherits from multiple parents
mcqs.answer: A class inherits from one direct parent class

mcqs.question: What is multiple inheritance?
options: A class inherits directly from more than one parent class
Multiple classes inherit from one parent
mcqs.answer: A class inherits directly from more than one parent class

mcqs.question: Which syntax demonstrates multiple inheritance?
mcqs.answer: class C(A, B):

mcqs.question: What is multilevel inheritance?
options: Inheritance forming a chain such as A → B → C
A class inheriting from unrelated functions
mcqs.answer: Inheritance forming a chain such as A → B → C

mcqs.question: What is hierarchical inheritance?
options: Multiple child classes inherit from the same parent
One child inherits from multiple parents
A class inherits through three levels
mcqs.answer: Multiple child classes inherit from the same parent

mcqs.question: What is hybrid inheritance?
options: A combination of two or more inheritance patterns
Inheritance used only with abstract classes
mcqs.answer: A combination of two or more inheritance patterns

mcqs.question: What is method overriding?
options: Defining a child class method with the same name as an inherited method
Deleting a method from the parent class
Calling two methods at the same time
Renaming every method in a class
mcqs.answer: Defining a child class method with the same name as an inherited method

mcqs.question: Why is method overriding useful?
options: It allows a subclass to provide specialized behavior
mcqs.answer: It allows a subclass to provide specialized behavior

mcqs.question: Which concept is strongly associated with method overriding?
mcqs.answer: Polymorphism

mcqs.question: What does polymorphism mean in OOP?
options: The same interface or operation can work with different object types
A class can have only one method
Every object must have the same data
A program can have only one class
mcqs.answer: The same interface or operation can work with different object types

mcqs.question: Which example best demonstrates polymorphism?
options: Calling `draw()` on different shape objects that each implement their own drawing behavior
mcqs.answer: Calling `draw()` on different shape objects that each implement their own drawing behavior

mcqs.question: What is duck typing in Python?
options: An object's suitability is determined by the operations it supports rather than its explicit class
A technique for creating duck-shaped classes
A method for checking only object identity
mcqs.answer: An object's suitability is determined by the operations it supports rather than its explicit class

mcqs.question: Which statement best represents duck typing?
options: If an object provides the required method, it can often be used regardless of its exact class
Only objects from the same class can be used
Every object must inherit from a special Duck class
Python checks the object's variable names only
mcqs.answer: If an object provides the required method, it can often be used regardless of its exact class

mcqs.question: Which built-in function is commonly used to access a parent implementation from a subclass?
mcqs.answer: super()

mcqs.question: What is the common purpose of `super()`?
options: To access methods or attributes through the superclass resolution mechanism
To create a completely unrelated object
mcqs.answer: To access methods or attributes through the superclass resolution mechanism

mcqs.question: Which statement can call the parent class's `__init__()` from a child class?
mcqs.answer: super().__init__()

mcqs.question: Why might a subclass call `super().__init__()`?
options: To initialize state defined by the parent class
To convert the class into a module
mcqs.answer: To initialize state defined by the parent class

mcqs.question: What happens if a child class does not override an inherited method?
options: It can normally use the inherited method
mcqs.answer: It can normally use the inherited method

mcqs.question: Can a child class add new methods that are not present in its parent?
mcqs.answer: Yes

mcqs.question: Can a subclass add its own attributes in addition to inherited attributes?
options: Only if the parent has no attributes
mcqs.answer: Yes

mcqs.question: What is method resolution order (MRO)?
options: The order Python follows when searching for methods and attributes in an inheritance hierarchy
The order in which variables are created
The order in which modules are installed
mcqs.answer: The order Python follows when searching for methods and attributes in an inheritance hierarchy

mcqs.question: Which attribute provides a class's method resolution order?
mcqs.answer: __mro__

mcqs.question: Which method can display the method resolution order of a class?
mcqs.answer: ClassName.mro()

mcqs.question: Which algorithm does Python use to determine MRO in multiple inheritance?
mcqs.answer: C3 linearization

mcqs.question: In multiple inheritance, why is MRO important?
options: It determines which class implementation is searched first
mcqs.answer: It determines which class implementation is searched first

mcqs.question: What is a common advantage of inheritance?
mcqs.answer: Code reuse through shared behavior

mcqs.question: Which relationship is commonly modeled using inheritance?
mcqs.answer: An 'is-a' relationship

mcqs.question: Which relationship is generally better represented by composition rather than inheritance?
mcqs.answer: A 'has-a' relationship

mcqs.question: If `Car` inherits from `Vehicle`, which statement is generally true?
options: A Vehicle must be a Car
Car cannot have its own methods
Vehicle automatically becomes an instance of Car
mcqs.answer: A Car is a Vehicle

mcqs.question: What does polymorphic code generally allow?
options: The same operation to work with objects providing compatible behavior
Only one object type to be processed
All objects to share identical implementations
mcqs.answer: The same operation to work with objects providing compatible behavior

mcqs.question: Which special method can be overridden to customize the `+` operator?
Which concept allows operators such as `+` to behave differently for different classes?
mcqs.answer: Operator overloading

mcqs.question: Which special method can define behavior for the `==` operator?
Which type of polymorphism is commonly demonstrated by method overriding in subclasses?
mcqs.answer: Runtime polymorphism

mcqs.question: What is the benefit of overriding a parent method instead of modifying the parent class?
options: A subclass can customize behavior while leaving the parent implementation available
It removes the parent class permanently
It prevents the subclass from having objects
mcqs.answer: A subclass can customize behavior while leaving the parent implementation available

mcqs.question: What does `super()` help avoid in many inheritance designs?
options: Hard-coding a specific parent class name when following the MRO
mcqs.answer: Hard-coding a specific parent class name when following the MRO

mcqs.question: Which statement about multiple inheritance in Python is correct?
options: A class can inherit from multiple base classes
Python allows only one base class
Multiple inheritance is possible only for built-in classes
mcqs.answer: A class can inherit from multiple base classes

mcqs.question: What is the diamond problem in multiple inheritance?
options: A hierarchy where two parent paths lead to a common ancestor
A class with exactly four methods
A syntax error caused by indentation
mcqs.answer: A hierarchy where two parent paths lead to a common ancestor

mcqs.question: How does Python's MRO help with the diamond inheritance problem?
options: It provides a consistent order for resolving inherited methods
mcqs.answer: It provides a consistent order for resolving inherited methods

mcqs.question: Which statement best summarizes inheritance and polymorphism?
options: Inheritance enables reuse and specialization, while polymorphism allows common operations to work across different object types
Inheritance removes objects and polymorphism removes classes
Both concepts are used only for file handling
mcqs.answer: Inheritance enables reuse and specialization, while polymorphism allows common operations to work across different object types
